title: Neethi: new brand, public site and app redesign
goal: A proper professional lawyer UI and layout with a modern look, made more interesting with dot-matrix texture and drawn SVGs. Every page reworked (the sidebar navigation was confusing, the look generic, the chat cramped, the pages cluttered). A public site built now: the real home is the public page, the current home moves to /dashboard. The product is named Neethi. The main thing is the AI colleague; the second is the Case workspace, our moat.
for_whom: A practising Sri Lankan lawyer: first as a visitor deciding whether to sign up, then every day in their cases, on a laptop and on a phone at court.

done_check.check: Brand: the product is Neethi everywhere a user sees a name (page titles, sidebar, public pages, sign-in and sign-up, emails we control); the logo is the single-stroke arch mark in oxblood with the lowercase wordmark 'neethi' in Instrument Sans 600; the favicon and app icon are the white arch on an oxblood or ink tile and read at 16 px. No 'sllaw' left in the UI.

The look is the agreed Oxblood direction, as tokens in globals.css for light and dark: ink #16140f on paper #fbfaf7, oxblood #7d1d2c the one action colour, its soft tint for law citations, a neutral tint for case-file citations; Instrument Sans for the interface, Source Serif 4 only for statute text, Geist Mono for small labels; the dot-matrix texture and line-drawn SVGs used on the landing, empty states and page headers. Navy and brass are gone. Clerk's sign-in and sign-up match.

Public landing at / in the agreed order: header (logo, Product, Coverage, Pricing, FAQ, Sign in, Start free); hero 'Introducing Neethi · Your AI colleague for Sri Lankan law' with a drawn chat preview citing real constitutional text; 'Introducing Case' as a split section (four points, fanned case papers), sharing with juniors marked Coming soon; 'Your colleague, at work' (four tiles); the law-as-it-stands band; Trust; Pricing; FAQ; closing banner; footer. Every quoted law is verbatim from our corpus.

Public pages /pricing (Free Rs. 0, Lawyer and Chambers with prices to be announced), /coverage (live counts of Acts and Laws, Revised Edition chapters and amendments followed, and the last update date, from kb in one cached query of a few rows), /privacy and /terms (placeholder text, plainly marked for the user to replace). They open without a session; signed in, the header offers 'Open Neethi' to /dashboard.
Today's Home is at /dashboard (greeting, a question box first, This week, Cases as docket cards); signing in lands there, and every in-app link to Home goes there.

One sidebar replaces the two: Dashboard, Cases, the open case expanded in place (Overview, Files, its chats, Case settings), other recent cases, Quick chats, and the account with the usage meter at the foot. From any page a lawyer can see which case they are in and get back to the dashboard in one click.

The chat, in a case and quick: the lawyer's message as an ink bubble, the answer as a card with law chips (oxblood tint) and file chips (neutral), its trail folded into one line; the sources panel shows the law in Source Serif with the cited text highlighted and its amendments on a timeline; the question box floats at the foot with attach and Playbooks. Streaming, stop, citations, the trail and playbooks behave as on main.

Every other page is in the same system: cases list, new case and onboarding, case overview (the workspace: header with court and next date, files, diary, ask), files and file details, case settings, usage, the document viewer, admin, and the 404.
Every page works at 390 px wide with no sideways scroll: the sidebar is a drawer, the sources panel a bottom sheet, tap targets at least 44 px; and every page reads in dark mode.

The colleague at work, as on the board 'App · The colleague at work': while it works, steps appear live in a lawyer's words on a dotted thread, with the working arch, a timer and Stop; finished, the trail folds to one line and opens into sentences (what it looked for, what it found, chips that open in the panel), thinking as a short excerpt, a playbook as a tag on the message and as a step; three citation kinds look the same in the answer and the panel: law (read, in force), the lawyer's file (read, at the page), not verified (amber, dashed, with the warning); a law's amendments drawn as a timeline from the changes the panel already loads (enactment year from the key, undated changes listed without a dot). No change to what the agent does or costs.
The app checks pass; a headed UI walk records a screenshot of each page in light, dark and at phone width (paths in progress), on the brief's own database.

scenarios.steps: A lawyer who has never heard of Neethi opens /, reads down the page, opens Pricing and Coverage, then presses Start free and signs up.
scenarios.expect: The landing reads as one story (colleague first, Case second); Coverage shows real counts; after sign-up the first-case setup opens, then the case, and later sign-ins land on /dashboard.

scenarios.steps: In a case, the lawyer asks 'Was he told why he was arrested?' and opens a citation; then does the same on a phone.
scenarios.expect: The answer card cites the Article and the file page; the law opens beside the thread in serif, highlighted, with its amendments; on the phone it opens as a sheet and the sidebar as a drawer.

scenarios.steps: A signed-in lawyer types the bare domain.
scenarios.expect: The landing shows with 'Open Neethi' in the header, which goes to /dashboard.

out_of_scope: Buying a domain (neethi.lk suggested); real prices; the legal wording of privacy and terms.
New features beyond the layout: search or a command palette, sharing cases with juniors (shown as Coming soon), reminders, a month calendar.
Any change to the agent, its prompts, tools or costs.
Translating the interface into Sinhala or Tamil.
Analytics, cookie banners, a blog or a waitlist.

decisions.note: Name Neethi (Sinhala නීති law, Tamil நீதி justice); no product of that name found; Kerala's 'Neeti' (Dharmabot AI) is the nearest. neethi.lk over .ai on price (user).
Logo: the arch (court doorway and lowercase n), minimal like Claude's mark; wordmark sans, not serif, which read as old firm (user).
Look: Oxblood over Ink & Emerald, Mono & Signal and Graphite & Saffron: the most Sri Lankan and the most legal while modern; navy and brass dropped (user).
Story: the AI colleague is the main thing; Case, the workspace, is the moat and comes second; one hero only (user).

Sign-up open (not a waitlist); pricing shows Free, Lawyer, Chambers without prices; coverage counts live; one brief and one PR built in stages (tokens and shell, chat, other app pages, public site) (user).

Reopened to add the chat's working parts (live steps, opened trail, playbooks, citation states, amendment timeline) after a board for them; the timeline is a drawing of corpus.chunk's changes, no new data (user).
Mockup agreed: claude.ai/artifact/4ghdf5b5xBRU7PvzfAHoKx (landing final; app boards give the direction, their sample content is not to be copied).
